description: A broadcast destination counts as drc.default_speed, so a transmission carrying data to it and to a peer that recommended a faster rung goes at the default.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. The burst from 0.0.1.3 holds CAPABILITY and MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6). Conn 1 sends 'hello' to 0.0.1.3 and then 'all' to the broadcast address 31.255.255.255 (C-0123), both at 1500. No recommendation can exist for a group or broadcast destination (C-0937), so it counts as drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long (plan 6.2 non-ARQ; interp C-1283), and the transmission takes the lowest rung over its addressees (C-0894, C-0930): WN 2 Long. The type 7 to 0.0.1.3 (C_PDU ID 0) carries SENDER-APPROACH (interp C-1286); the type 7 to broadcast (C_PDU ID 1, GROUP ADDRESS 1, address size 7, C-0122, C-0133) carries EMPTY (C-0398, C-0937). Not every addressee is recorded Ed4, so no PADDING: the rest of the block is the modem's zero fill (C-1154).
